module_summary: Inserts a PTP tag into AXI-Stream tuser: a tag register is loaded from a tag valid/ready input and held for one frame, gating stream flow until a tag is available.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input beat valid, forwarded when a tag is held.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready gated by downstream ready and tag_valid_reg.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Stream payload passed straight through to m_axis_tdata.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Frame end; releases held tag after last beat.

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Input sideband merged with tag into user.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid when input valid and tag held.

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Output tuser carrying inserted tag field.

anchors.name: user
anchors.why: tuser with tag_reg overwritten at TAG_OFFSET.

anchors.name: s_axis_tag
anchors.why: Incoming PTP tag value loaded into tag_reg.

anchors.name: s_axis_tag_valid
anchors.why: Tag valid; sets tag_valid_reg when idle.

anchors.name: s_axis_tag_ready
anchors.why: Tag ready while no tag is held.

anchors.name: tag_reg
anchors.why: Holds the tag for the whole frame being forwarded.

anchors.name: tag_valid_reg
anchors.why: Tag-held flag gating stream ready/valid and tag acceptance.

groups.name: Tag holding
groups.description: Accepts one tag, holds it until frame tlast transfers.

groups.name: Stream pass-through
groups.description: Data/keep/last forwarded, handshake gated by tag-held flag.

groups.name: User merge
groups.description: Overwrites tuser tag field with held tag.
